tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Company profile for Brazilian Bikinis / Mar Egeu: family-owned Sao Paulo manufacturer since 1971; wholesale, private label and custom design; contacts and languages.

tools.name: get_buying_options
tools.description: The three ways to buy: ready-made (any 12 styles), private label (any 80 styles) and custom design (120 per style), with MOQ, estimates and lead times.

tools.name: get_production_options
tools.description: Production, fabric, lead-time, payment and shipping facts plus the three commercial routes.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: FAQ question/answer pairs, optionally filtered case-insensitively.

tools.name: get_routes
tools.description: The three commercial routes (name, minimum, description).

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search styles by name, base style or category. Style metadata only; prices come from get_price_list.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one style by exact SKU, base style or name (falls back to a partial match). No prices.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List product categories with style counts.

tools.name: get_price_list
tools.description: Request the wholesale price list. Requires full name and email; the request is registered as a lead and prices are returned only after successful registration.

tools.name: create_inquiry
tools.description: Submit an inquiry about a product or order; forwarded to the Brazilian Bikinis team.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_price_list · Private data: get_company_info, get_buying_options · Public sink: get_price_list, create_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_price_list · Private data: get_company_info, get_buying_options · Public sink: get_price_list, create_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
